title: I made a free hosting for AI-made browser games
author: perki51
selftext:
I keep seeing really creative games people make with AI, and most of them never leave the chat they were made in. Hosting a game and then trying to get anyone to play it is no fun, so the game just sits there.

So I built this website: [https://juicyjuicy.games/](https://juicyjuicy.games/r/t6kk9q) \- you can publish your game with just one prompt and anyone can play in the browser. It's free to publish and free to play. No ads, and I don't make any money from it (it's non-commercial, mods :).

It's new and small. I launched it this month and so far it's just me and a few friends who put some games on it. I want to build a community of people making these games, so if you want to share your project, see whether people like it and what's their opinion on it, feel free to join! Thanks :)
